findings.evidence: The full app suite reports four failures, six errors, and fourteen skipped tests; the support boundary test and all targeted support/inbox tests pass.
findings.why_it_matters: A non-green full suite prevents an unconditional release claim even though the current feature scope is green.
findings.required_action: Resolve or separately baseline the assessment/attempt failures before final release sign-off.

findings.evidence: NOTIFICATION_INBOX_ENABLED defaults to false; the healthy local app container is still at Flyway V70 and was not used as current-feature runtime evidence.
findings.why_it_matters: Intent tests alone cannot prove that a bell item is materialized by the worker.
findings.required_action: Run the current V71-V76 application with NOTIFICATION_INBOX_ENABLED=true and verify a pending support intent reaches the inbox.

findings.evidence: Visible Playwright smoke covered login and unauthenticated protected-route redirects only; no valid tenant/platform-admin test accounts were available for the CRUD and isolation flow.
findings.why_it_matters: Builds and 401 probes cannot prove fan-out, read-state, exact target navigation, or cross-account isolation.
findings.required_action: Repeat the browser flow with authorized local test accounts after the current runtime is deployed to the controlled environment.
